sourceFacts.name: Zwartkop
sourceFacts.facts: Male black cap; female rust-brown cap; juvenile may have brown cap; song with prominent clear notes at end; do not infer sex solely from juvenile cap

sourceFacts.name: Tuinfluiter
sourceFacts.facts: Uniform grey-brown back and grey-white belly, grey patch at neck side, short blunt bill, fast fluid song without strong clear blackcap-like terminal whistles

sourceFacts.name: Grasmus
sourceFacts.facts: White throat, warm rusty wing edges, grey cap and pinkish breast in breeding male; somewhat scratchy variable song

sourceFacts.name: Braamsluiper
sourceFacts.facts: Grey head and dark ear coverts, clear white throat, absence of same warm rust on wings; rattling song
